answer: An agent network counters Sybil attacks through optical profilometry of physical tokens embedded with jade, onyx, and dried yarrow. Nodes maintain identities by hashing micro-surface reflections under structured light. An attacker incurs non-trivial hardware costs procuring specialized physical sensor-token pairs per node rather than duplicating software threads. However, surface wear and particulate buildup drift baseline readings over time, occasionally rejecting legitimate participants.
